sections.overview:
### Overview
> Source: https://primer.style/ · https://github.com/primer/primitives

Primer is the design system for **GitHub.com**. It ships in three framework implementations — **Primer React** (`@primer/react`), **Primer CSS**, and **Primer ViewComponents** (Rails) — all driven by two shared foundations: **Primer Primitives** (design tokens) and **Octicons** (icons).

### Structure
- **Primer Primitives** (`@primer/primitives`): tokens for color, size/space, typography, borders, and shadows, distributed as CSS variables and source **JSON5 in DTCG format**.
- **Octicons** (`@primer/octicons`): GitHub's open-source SVG icon set.
- **Components**: ~65 documented components for dense product UI.
- **Accessibility**: a dedicated accessibility site (`primer.style/accessibility`) with foundations, design guidance, patterns, and tooling.

### Agent-readiness signal
Primer's standout machine-readable signal is its **DTCG-format tokens with `org.primer.llm` extensions** — each token carries `usage` arrays and natural-language `rules` for agents (e.g. borderWidth.thick: "MUST use for focus rings on interactive elements"). See the Agent Guidance section.

### Known gaps
No first-party MCP server and no `llms.txt` (verified 404 at `https://primer.style/llms.txt`).
sections.colors:
### Colors
> Source: https://primer.style/foundations/color · https://github.com/primer/primitives

Color tokens are **functional / role-based** (not palette-named at point of use), grouped into `fgColor-*` (foreground), `bgColor-*` (background), `borderColor-*`, plus pattern groups (`button-*`, `control-*`, `data-*`, `focus`, `overlay`). Values below are the **light** theme.

### Color modes (9 themes)
Primer ships nine functional theme files — far beyond a single light/dark pair, including **high-contrast** and **color-vision** variants.

| Theme file | Purpose |
| --- | --- |
| `light` | Default light |
| `light_high_contrast` | Light, increased contrast |
| `light_colorblind` | Light, deuteranopia/protanopia-safe |
| `light_tritanopia` | Light, tritanopia-safe |
| `dark` | Default dark |
| `dark_dimmed` | Lower-luminance dark |
| `dark_high_contrast` | Dark, increased contrast |
| `dark_colorblind` | Dark, deuteranopia/protanopia-safe |
| `dark_tritanopia` | Dark, tritanopia-safe |

Applied via `data-color-mode` (`auto`/`light`/`dark`), `data-light-theme`, and `data-dark-theme` attributes.

### Foreground (light)
- **Default** (`--fgColor-default`): primary text — `#1f2328`
- **Muted** (`--fgColor-muted`): secondary text — `#59636e`
- **Accent / Link** (`--fgColor-accent`, `--fgColor-link`): `#0969da`
- **Success** (`--fgColor-success`): `#1a7f37`
- **Attention** (`--fgColor-attention`): `#9a6700`
- **Danger** (`--fgColor-danger`): `#d1242f`
- **Done** (`--fgColor-done`): `#8250df`
- **Sponsors** (`--fgColor-sponsors`): `#bf3989`
- **Disabled** (`--fgColor-disabled`): `#818b98`
- **onEmphasis** (`--fgColor-onEmphasis`): text on emphasis fills — `#ffffff`

### Background (light)
- **Default** (`--bgColor-default`): `#ffffff`
- **Muted / Inset** (`--bgColor-muted`, `--bgColor-inset`): `#f6f8fa`
- **Emphasis / Inverse** (`--bgColor-emphasis`): `#25292e`
- **Accent emphasis / muted** (`--bgColor-accent-emphasis` / `-muted`): `#0969da` / `#ddf4ff`
- **Success emphasis / muted**: `#1f883d` / `#dafbe1`
- **Attention emphasis / muted**: `#9a6700` / `#fff8c5`
- **Danger emphasis / muted**: `#cf222e` / `#ffebe9`

### Border (light)
- **Default** (`--borderColor-default`): `#d1d9e0`
- **Muted** (`--borderColor-muted`): `#d1d9e0b3`
- **Emphasis** (`--borderColor-emphasis`): `#818b98`
- **Accent emphasis** (`--borderColor-accent-emphasis`): `#0969da`
- **Translucent** (`--borderColor-translucent`): `#1f232826`

### Focus
- **Outline** (`--focus-outlineColor`): `#0969da`

### Not published here
Dark / dark-dimmed / high-contrast / colorblind hex values are per-theme files (see the Primitives Storybook); the public color page renders only the site's active theme.
sections.typography:
### Typography
> Source: https://primer.style/foundations/typography · https://github.com/primer/primitives/blob/main/src/tokens/functional/typography/font-stack.json5

Type tokens use **`rem` units** (for accessible browser zoom) and **unitless line-heights** that align to a 4px grid.

### Font stacks (`fontStack-*`)
- **System / Sans-serif** (`--fontStack-sansSerif`): `'Mona Sans VF', -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, 'Segoe UI', 'Noto Sans', Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif, ...` — **Mona Sans**–first with system fallbacks.
- **Display** (`--fontStack-sansSerifDisplay`): same family, semantically distinct for headings/titles.
- **Monospace** (`--fontStack-monospace`): `ui-monospace, SFMono-Regular, SF Mono, Menlo, Consolas, Liberation Mono, monospace` — code and tabular data.

### Type size scale (`--text-*-size`, base scale)
| Token | rem | px | Use |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `xs` | 0.75rem | 12px | Captions, compact UI |
| `sm` | 0.875rem | 14px | Default body/UI text |
| `md` | 1rem | 16px | Large body, small titles |
| `lg` | 1.25rem | 20px | Medium titles |
| `xl` | 2rem | 32px | Large titles / page headings |
| `2xl` | 2.5rem | 40px | Display / hero |

### Font weights
| Token | Value |
| --- | --- |
| `light` | 300 |
| `normal` | 400 |
| `medium` | 500 |
| `semibold` | 600 |

### Line heights (unitless)
| Token | Value |
| --- | --- |
| `tight` | 1.25 |
| `snug` | 1.375 |
| `normal` | 1.5 |
| `relaxed` | 1.625 |
| `loose` | 1.75 |

### Functional styles
Shorthand tokens combine size + family + weight + line-height into one `font` declaration — e.g. `text.display` (40px / medium / sansSerifDisplay), `text.title.large` (32px), `text.title.medium` (20px), `text.title.small` (16px).

### Best practices (published)
Stress efficient, clean reading; avoid color as a primary emphasis method; keep line length ≤ ~80 characters; content is left-aligned, ragged-right; use weight tokens (never arbitrary weight numbers); use semantic heading markup (don't reorder heading tags for visual effect).
sections.layout:
### Layout
> Source: https://primer.style/product/primitives · https://primer.style/components

### Base size scale (`--base-size-*`, px)
A single px scale drives both sizing and spacing: **2, 4, 6, 8, 12, 16, 20, 24, 28, 32, 36, 40, 44, 48, 64, 80, 96, 112, 128**. Anchored on an **8px rhythm** with finer 2/4/6px steps for dense UI.

### Functional space scale (`--space-*`)
| Token | Value | Guidance (from token `rules`) |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `xxs` | 2px | Form-field separators, tight dividers |
| `xs` | 4px | Small component spacing, badge padding |
| `sm` | 8px | **Default** component spacing, flex/grid gap |
| `md` | 12px | Relaxed container padding, section separators |
| `lg` | 16px | Major layout divisions between content blocks |
| `xl` | 24px | Large section separation, page divisions |

### Control sizes (`--control-*`)
Interactive controls have preset heights: `xsmall` 24px, `small` 28px, `medium` 32px (and larger). Minimum touch target: **16px fine** pointer, **44px coarse** pointer (`--control-minTarget-*`) — an explicit accessibility floor.

### Layout components
**PageLayout** (header / main / pane / footer regions), **SplitPageLayout** (two-column with sidebar), and **Stack** (responsive horizontal/vertical flow). Density is tuned for information-rich developer UI (repos, diffs, issues).

### Not published
No fixed 12-column grid spec or named container max-widths on the public foundations pages; breakpoints ship as `functional/size/breakpoints` tokens.
sections.depth:
### Elevation & Depth
> Source: https://primer.style/foundations/color

Primer is **border-forward and restrained** — hierarchy comes primarily from `borderColor-*` and surface (`bgColor-inset`, `bgColor-emphasis`) tokens, with shadows reserved for floating surfaces. Shadow tokens split into **resting** (subtle, for stationary elements) and **floating** (for overlays).

### Shadow tokens (light)
| Token | Value |
| --- | --- |
| `--shadow-resting-xsmall` | `0 1px 1px 0 #1f23280d` |
| `--shadow-resting-small` | `0 1px 1px 0 #1f23280a, 0 1px 2px 0 #1f232808` |
| `--shadow-resting-medium` | `0 1px 1px 0 #25292e1a, 0 3px 6px 0 #25292e1f` |
| `--shadow-floating-small` | `0 0 0 1px #d1d9e040, 0 6px 12px -3px #25292e0a, 0 6px 18px 0 #25292e1f` |
| `--shadow-floating-medium` | 4-layer stack, `0 8px 16px -4px` … through `0 48px 96px -24px #25292e14` |
| `--shadow-floating-large` | `0 0 0 1px #d1d9e000, 0 40px 80px 0 #25292e3d` |
| `--shadow-floating-xlarge` | `0 0 0 1px #d1d9e000, 0 56px 112px 0 #25292e52` |
| `--shadow-inset` | `inset 0 1px 0 0 #1f23280a` |

### Border widths (as elevation alternative)
Primer prefers `boxShadow.thin/thick/thicker` (inset shadows using `borderWidth` 1/2/4px) to add emphasis **without layout shift** rather than heavier drop shadows.
sections.shapes:
### Shapes
> Source: https://github.com/primer/primitives/blob/main/src/tokens/functional/size/radius.json5

### Border-radius scale (`--borderRadius-*`)
| Token | Value | Guidance (from token `rules`) |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `small` | 3px | Badges, tags, labels, small inputs (< 16px height) |
| `medium` | 6px | **Default** — buttons, inputs, cards, containers |
| `large` | 12px | Dialogs, cards, modals |
| `full` | 9999px | Avatars, pill badges, circular buttons |
| `default` | → `medium` (6px) | Semantic default for standard components |

Corners are small and utilitarian; `medium` (6px) is the documented default. Each radius token also carries a `codeSyntax.web` mapping to a legacy utility class (e.g. `.rounded-2`).

### Border widths (`--borderWidth-*`)
| Token | Value | Guidance |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `thin` | 1px | Default border width |
| `thick` | 2px | Focus rings, selected/emphasis borders |
| `thicker` | 4px | Strong emphasis (use sparingly) |
| `default` | → `thin` (1px) | Semantic default |
sections.iconography:
### Iconography
> Source: https://primer.style/octicons · https://github.com/primer/octicons

**Octicons** — "a set of SVG icons built by GitHub for GitHub." A governed, product-specific, open-source icon library.

### Grids & sizing
- Designed on **16px and 24px** grids (the two canonical sizes shipped for most glyphs).
- Distributed as SVGs plus platform libraries: `@primer/octicons` (Node/JS API), `@primer/octicons-react` (React components), `@primer/styled-octicons`, and Ruby (`octicons` gem, Rails/Jekyll helpers).

### Usage
Icon color is driven by color tokens (e.g. `--fgColor-muted`, `--control-iconColor-rest`) rather than hardcoded fills, so icons inherit the active theme.

### Not published
No semantic icon-category taxonomy (object / action / indicator) exposed in the public docs; selection is by name/search.
sections.components:
### Components
> Source: https://primer.style/components

~65 documented components for dense product UI, available across Primer React / CSS / ViewComponents, each with accessibility guidance baked in.

### Selected inventory
| Category | Components |
| --- | --- |
| Actions | Button, ButtonGroup, IconButton, ActionBar, ActionList, ActionMenu |
| Data display | DataTable, TreeView, Timeline, Label, LabelGroup, Token, StateLabel, CounterLabel, Avatar, AvatarStack, BranchName |
| Navigation | NavList, UnderlineNav, UnderlinePanels, Breadcrumbs, Pagination, PageHeader |
| Layout | PageLayout, SplitPageLayout, Stack, Card |
| Overlays | Overlay, AnchoredOverlay, Dialog, ConfirmationDialog, Popover, Tooltip, SelectPanel |
| Forms | FormControl, TextInput, TextInputWithTokens, Textarea, Select, Checkbox(+Group), Radio(+Group), Autocomplete, SegmentedControl, ToggleSwitch |
| Feedback | Banner, InlineMessage, Blankslate, ProgressBar, Spinner, Skeleton (Text/Box/Avatar) |
| Misc | Heading, Text, Link, Truncate, RelativeTime, KeybindingHint, Details, CircleBadge |

### States
Component color states are tokenized (`-rest`, `-hover`, `-active`, `-disabled`, `-selected`) — e.g. `--button-primary-bgColor-rest` `#1f883d` → `-hover` `#1c8139` → `-active` `#197935`; `--control-*` tokens cover form-control states including `-danger`, `-warning`, `-success`, and `-checked`.
sections.dataviz:
### Data Visualization
> Source: https://primer.style/foundations/color

Data-viz is **not a headline Primer chapter** — there is no charting-component spec or documented chart library in Primer. Charting lives in product code, not the core system.

### What does exist: a data-viz color scale (`--data-*`)
Primer ships a categorical color palette intended for charts, each hue with an `-emphasis` and `-muted` pair. Light-theme emphasis values:

| Hue | `-emphasis` | Hue | `-emphasis` |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| blue | `#006edb` | green | `#30a147` |
| purple | `#894ceb` | teal | `#179b9b` |
| pink | `#ce2c85` | pine | `#167e53` |
| coral | `#d43511` | lime | `#527a29` |
| orange | `#eb670f` | olive | `#64762d` |
| red | `#df0c24` | lemon | `#866e04` |
| plum | `#a830e8` | yellow | `#b88700` |
| brown | `#856d4c` | auburn | `#9d615c` |
| gray | `#808fa3` | | |

### Known gaps
Color tokens only — no chart components, axis/legend/tooltip specs, or chart-type guidance published (comparable to enterprise product systems that don't treat data-viz as first-class).
sections.content:
### Content: Voice & Tone
> Source: https://primer.style/accessibility/patterns/accessible-notifications-and-messages/

Primer does **not** publish a standalone UX-writing / voice-and-tone standard on the design-system site. Content guidance is **embedded and partial**:
- Per-component usage notes (labels, empty states via **Blankslate**, error/validation text via **FormControl** and **InlineMessage**).
- An accessibility pattern for **accessible messaging** — how updates and messages should be communicated inclusively (announcements, status, severity).
- Typography best practices touch on tone indirectly (efficient, clean reading; avoid color as emphasis).

### Not published
No dedicated content-design chapter (terminology, capitalization, product-voice principles) comparable to a full UX-writing standard. Broader GitHub brand voice lives outside the Primer docs.
sections.accessibility:
### Accessibility
> Source: https://primer.style/accessibility

Accessibility is a first-class GitHub commitment with its own site section, targeting **WCAG 2.1 AA**.

### Published resources
- **Foundations** (`/accessibility/foundations/`): policies, principles, frameworks.
- **Design guidance** (`/accessibility/design-guidance/`): inclusive visual-design standards.
- **Copilot Accessibility Principles** (`/accessibility/foundations/copilot-principles/`): designing accessible generative/agentic AI experiences.
- **Annotation Toolkit** (`/accessibility/tools-and-resources/annotation-toolkit/`): design + dev annotation guidelines.
- **Accessibility for Primer UI** (`/accessibility/patterns/primer-components/`): per-component/pattern guidance (keyboard, ARIA).
- **Accessible messaging** (`/accessibility/patterns/accessible-notifications-and-messages/`).

### Enforced in code
- **ESLint plugins**: `eslint-plugin-github` and `eslint-plugin-primer-react` catch accessibility + correct-usage violations at lint time.
- **Token-level a11y**: color modes include high-contrast + color-vision themes; `--control-minTarget-coarse` (44px) enforces touch targets; `borderWidth.thick` (2px) is mandated for focus rings.

### Notes
Component pages document keyboard and ARIA patterns; exact per-component conformance status is tracked in Primer's repos rather than a single public matrix.
sections.dosdonts:
### Do's and Don'ts
> Source: https://primer.style/foundations/typography · https://primer.style/components

### Published do/don't guidance
- **Typography**: Do use weight CSS variables for `font-weight`; **Don't** use arbitrary weight numbers. Do use semantic title markup with styles; **Don't** reorder heading tags to achieve a visual look.
- **Per-component pages**: most components document usage do/don't and accessibility caveats.
- **Token `rules`**: DTCG tokens embed prescriptive guidance, e.g. `borderRadius.small` — "Do NOT use for buttons or cards"; `borderWidth.thick` — "MUST use for focus rings … Do NOT use for subtle dividers."

### Enforced as code
Guardrails are backed by **ESLint plugins** (`eslint-plugin-primer-react`, `eslint-plugin-github`) that flag incorrect component and accessibility usage — do/don't as lint rules, not just prose.
sections.agent:
### Agent Guidance
> Source: https://github.com/primer/primitives

Primer has no marketed "agent" surface, but its **token layer is unusually machine-readable**, which is its real agent strength.

### DTCG tokens with agent metadata
Source tokens are **W3C DTCG JSON5** (`$value` / `$type` / `$description`) and carry two custom extensions:
- **`org.primer.llm`**: `usage` arrays + natural-language `rules` per token. Examples:
  - `borderWidth.thick` → "MUST use for focus rings on interactive elements. Do NOT use for subtle dividers."
  - `space.sm` → "Default (8px). Use for standard component spacing…"
  - `fontStack.monospace` → "MUST use for all code display."
- **`org.primer.figma`**: collection + scopes (+ `codeSyntax.web` mapping tokens to legacy utility classes) for design-tool round-tripping.

### Distribution
- `@primer/primitives` (npm) → CSS variables + JSON/JS exports.
- Open-source repos (`primer/primitives`, `primer/react`, `primer/octicons`), Storybook, and the docs site.

### Known gaps / Not published
- **No first-party MCP server** confirmed.
- **No `llms.txt`** — verified **404** at `https://primer.style/llms.txt`.
- Strong at the token layer; thinner agent-distribution tooling than systems that ship an MCP or `llms.txt`.
